title: Local generation of module sheaves bounded by a cardinal
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\kappa$ a cardinal. Define $\operatorname{IsCardinalGenerated}(\mathcal F,\kappa)$ to mean that there is a set $C$ of open subsets of $X$ with $\bigcup_{U\in C}U=X$, and for each $U\in C$ a subset $S_U\subseteq\mathcal F(U)$ with $|S_U|\leq\kappa$, such that for every $x\in U$ the germs of $S_U$ span the stalk $\mathcal F_x$ over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. For infinite $\kappa$ this is the local $\kappa$-generation of Stacks Tag 077L.
